001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.serialize.BlockPos;
005
006import java.util.Map;
007import java.util.Objects;
008import java.util.UUID;
009
010/**
011 * Minimal information about a shop.
012 */
013public class ShopInfoStorage {
014
015  private final String world;
016  private final BlockPos position;
017  private final String owner;
018  private final double price;
019  private final String item;
020  private final int unlimited;
021  private final int shopType;
022  private final String extra;
023  private final String currency;
024  private final boolean disableDisplay;
025  private final String taxAccount;
026  private final String inventoryWrapperName;
027  private final String symbolLink;
028  private final Map<UUID, String> permission;
029
030  public ShopInfoStorage(final String world, final BlockPos position, final QUser owner, final double price, final String item, final int unlimited, final int shopType, final String extra, final String currency, final boolean disableDisplay, final QUser taxAccount, final String inventoryWrapperName, final String symbolLink, final Map<UUID, String> permission) {
031
032    this.world = world;
033    this.position = position;
034    this.owner = owner.serialize();
035    this.price = price;
036    this.item = item;
037    this.unlimited = unlimited;
038    this.shopType = shopType;
039    this.extra = extra;
040    this.currency = currency;
041    this.disableDisplay = disableDisplay;
042    if(taxAccount != null) {
043      this.taxAccount = taxAccount.serialize();
044    } else {
045      this.taxAccount = null;
046    }
047    this.inventoryWrapperName = inventoryWrapperName;
048    this.symbolLink = symbolLink;
049    this.permission = permission;
050  }
051
052  public String getWorld() {
053
054    return this.world;
055  }
056
057  public BlockPos getPosition() {
058
059    return this.position;
060  }
061
062  public String getOwner() {
063
064    return this.owner;
065  }
066
067  public double getPrice() {
068
069    return this.price;
070  }
071
072  public String getItem() {
073
074    return this.item;
075  }
076
077  public int getUnlimited() {
078
079    return this.unlimited;
080  }
081
082  public int getShopType() {
083
084    return this.shopType;
085  }
086
087  public String getExtra() {
088
089    return this.extra;
090  }
091
092  public String getCurrency() {
093
094    return this.currency;
095  }
096
097  public boolean isDisableDisplay() {
098
099    return this.disableDisplay;
100  }
101
102  public String getTaxAccount() {
103
104    return this.taxAccount;
105  }
106
107  public String getInventoryWrapperName() {
108
109    return this.inventoryWrapperName;
110  }
111
112  public String getSymbolLink() {
113
114    return this.symbolLink;
115  }
116
117  public Map<UUID, String> getPermission() {
118
119    return this.permission;
120  }
121
122  @Override
123  public boolean equals(final Object o) {
124
125    if(o == this) return true;
126    if(!(o instanceof ShopInfoStorage)) return false;
127    final ShopInfoStorage other = (ShopInfoStorage)o;
128    return Double.compare(this.getPrice(), other.getPrice()) == 0
129           && this.getUnlimited() == other.getUnlimited()
130           && this.getShopType() == other.getShopType()
131           && this.isDisableDisplay() == other.isDisableDisplay()
132           && Objects.equals(this.getWorld(), other.getWorld())
133           && Objects.equals(this.getPosition(), other.getPosition())
134           && Objects.equals(this.getOwner(), other.getOwner())
135           && Objects.equals(this.getItem(), other.getItem())
136           && Objects.equals(this.getExtra(), other.getExtra())
137           && Objects.equals(this.getCurrency(), other.getCurrency())
138           && Objects.equals(this.getTaxAccount(), other.getTaxAccount())
139           && Objects.equals(this.getInventoryWrapperName(), other.getInventoryWrapperName())
140           && Objects.equals(this.getSymbolLink(), other.getSymbolLink())
141           && Objects.equals(this.getPermission(), other.getPermission());
142  }
143
144  @Override
145  public int hashCode() {
146
147    return Objects.hash(this.getPrice(), this.getUnlimited(), this.getShopType(), this.isDisableDisplay(), this.getWorld(), this.getPosition(), this.getOwner(), this.getItem(), this.getExtra(), this.getCurrency(), this.getTaxAccount(), this.getInventoryWrapperName(), this.getSymbolLink(), this.getPermission());
148  }
149
150  @Override
151  public String toString() {
152
153    return "ShopInfoStorage(world=" + this.getWorld() + ", position=" + this.getPosition() + ", owner=" + this.getOwner() + ", price=" + this.getPrice() + ", item=" + this.getItem() + ", unlimited=" + this.getUnlimited() + ", shopType=" + this.getShopType() + ", extra=" + this.getExtra() + ", currency=" + this.getCurrency() + ", disableDisplay=" + this.isDisableDisplay() + ", taxAccount=" + this.getTaxAccount() + ", inventoryWrapperName=" + this.getInventoryWrapperName() + ", symbolLink=" + this.getSymbolLink() + ", permission=" + this.getPermission() + ")";
154  }
155}
